verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a campaign-centric 'Get campaign report: clicked' endpoint. That is a per-campaign report, not a per-contact engagement history. Reconstructing a contact's sent/opened/clicked timeline by iterating campaign reports would be a developer workaround, not the documented capability. Nothing in the pack documents an API endpoint returning a contact's sent, opened and clicked activity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read per-person engagement history — what was sent, opened, clicked — through the API for any contact
